original: ETA: The bus is here now.
english: ETA: The bus is here now.
spanish: ETA: El bus esta aqui ahora.

original: Press F or ESC to close.
english: Press F or ESC to close.
spanish: Presiona F o ESC para cerrar.

original: The bus is AI-driven and does NOT stop for unexpected obstacles. To avoid trouble, keep in mind:
english: The bus is AI-driven and does NOT stop for unexpected obstacles. To avoid trouble, keep in mind:
spanish: El bus es manejado por IA y NO se detiene ante obstaculos imprevistos. Para evitar problemas, tene presente:

original: Don't leave vehicles parked at the stops. The bus will collide on arrival.
english: Don't leave vehicles parked at the stops. The bus will collide on arrival.
spanish: No dejes vehiculos estacionados en las paradas. El bus va a colisionar al llegar.

original: Don't leave abandoned vehicles on the route. The bus does not dodge them.
english: Don't leave abandoned vehicles on the route. The bus does not dodge them.
spanish: No dejes vehiculos abandonados sobre la ruta. El bus no los esquiva.

original: Don't get in the bus's way. It does not brake for players or zombies.
english: Don't get in the bus's way. It does not brake for players or zombies.
spanish: No te interpongas en el camino del bus. No frena ante jugadores ni zombies.

original: The bus is indestructible during service: if you crash into it, yours is the one that breaks.
english: The bus is indestructible during service: if you crash into it, yours is the one that breaks.
spanish: El bus es indestructible durante el servicio: si chocas con tu vehiculo, el que se rompe es el tuyo.

original: To board, wait at the stop and sit in any passenger seat as soon as it stops.
english: To board, wait at the stop and sit in any passenger seat as soon as it stops.
spanish: Para subirte, esperalo en la parada y sentate en cualquier asiento de pasajero apenas se detenga.

original: Spawn launches the selected route. Stop removes the vehicle. Reset respawns at wp 0. Pause freezes the run.
english: Spawn launches the selected route. Stop removes the vehicle. Reset respawns at wp 0. Pause freezes the run.
spanish: Spawn lanza la ruta seleccionada. Detener quita el vehiculo. Reset reaparece en wp 0. Pausa congela la corrida.

original: Only one mode is active at a time. Normal: cruise (Stanley+FF). Parking: exact replay for fine maneuvers. Maneuver: replay for 90deg corners / roundabouts. Reverse: backward driving (vehicle must be stopped). Mark event tags the current waypoint as a stop.
english: Only one mode is active at a time. Normal: cruise (Stanley+FF). Parking: exact replay for fine maneuvers. Maneuver: replay for 90deg corners / roundabouts. Reverse: backward driving (vehicle must be stopped). Mark event tags the current waypoint as a stop.
spanish: Solo un modo activo a la vez. Normal: crucero (Stanley+FF). Parking: replay exacto para maniobras finas. Maniobra: replay para curvas 90grados / rotondas. Reversa: marcha atras (el vehiculo debe estar detenido). Marcar evento etiqueta el waypoint actual como parada.

original: Select a route to see its info
english: Select a route to see its info
spanish: Elegi una toma para ver su info
